notes.title: Have a HOT DOG for the Steam Summer Sale with Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
Hello there fellow corgi lovers!

With the Steam Summer Sale, Patch 1.2.1 is out! We are adding in a new, adorable hot dog skin for our favorite virtual corgi, and we hope you like it! In addition, Stunt Corgi VR will be 50% off during the Steam Summer Sale! It's the best time to buy Stunt Corgi VR, so tell your VR friends to get it!

[u]ADDITIONS[/u]
[list]
    [*]The Hot Dog skin has been added to the game. Try it out today!
 [/list]

notes.title: The Oculus Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are excited to announce that we have added Oculus Rift and Oculus Touch support. To celebrate, Stunt Corgi will be 34% off! Be sure to tell your friends and family about Stunt Corgi VR!

[u]ADDITIONS[/u]
[list]
    [*]Oculus Rift support has been added to Stunt Corgi! Use your Oculus Rift to make crazy and fun stunts. Oculus Touch controller support is included.
 [/list]

[u]BUG FIXES[/u]
[list] 
    [*]General physics changes and improvements.
    [*]Launching a Corgi though a portal to the outside of the gate will prevent the Corgi’s return.
[/list]

[u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u]
[list]
    [*]Menu sounds will play without the controller menus open when pressing the track pad.  
    [*]Having a fan under a jump waypoint will break the Corgi’s pathing.
[/list]

If there are any issues that you find, please let us know in the Steam Community page. Feel free to reach out to us on all social media platforms. If you have any suggestions, we would love to hear them, being new props, items, features, or levels. 

-	The Stunt Corgi Team

notes.title: Patch Notes – 1.1.0
notes.content:
We are proud to announce our first content update! We have been working hard to make sure that Stunt Corgi is the best it can be. 

[u]ADDITIONS[/u]
Teleport
[list]
    [*]By popular request, we have added Teleport to the game! Players are now able to teleport throughout the play area using either hand. You can Teleport by holding down the Grip button and pulling the trigger on the Vive Controller. The tutorial  has been updated as well.
[/list]

[u]BUG FIXES[/u]
Prop Interactions
[list]
    [*]Corgi will now interact with a skateboard after being fired from a cannon onto the skateboard
    [*]Jumping onto a Skateboard no longer ends Corgi's movement
    [*]Corgi will fire though props properly
    [*]Example Levels have been modified slightly
    [*]Additional interactions have been fixed
[/list]
Sound FX
[list]
    [*]Due to something called ‘Child Labor Laws,’ the sounds of cheering children have been removed from the game. Well Done!
[/list]

[u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u]
[list]
    [*]Rapidly starting and stopping Play will cause unstable physics in props.
    [*]Some example levels may not complete exactly as intended
[/list]

If there are any issues that you find, please let us know in the Steam Community page. Feel free to reach out to us on all social media platforms. If you have any suggestions, we would love to hear them, being new props, items, features, or levels. 

-	The Stunt Corgi Team

notes.title: Patch Notes – 1.0.4
notes.content:
This patch has a few fixes, and we have identified some additional issues that some players may have found. We will be addressing these issues within our next Content Patch.

[u]BUG FIXES[/u]
[list]
    [*]Corgi will now progress to the next waypoint if a waypoint is inside of a cannon prop.
[/list]

[u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u]
[list]
    [*]Corgi will not interact with a skateboard after being fired from a cannon onto the skateboard.
    [*]Corgi will sometimes not knock down objects from a cannon.
    [*]Corgi will sometimes not load into the level's starting position
    [*]Corgi can erratically spin when shot out of the cannon.
[/list]

If there are any issues that you find, please let us know in the Steam Community page. Feel free to reach out to us on all social media platforms. If you have any suggestions, we would love to hear them, being new props, items, features, or levels. 

-	The Stunt Corgi Team

notes.title: Patch Notes – 1.0.3
notes.content:
This patch has a few fan-requested features. We will be adding more improvements in the next few patches, so stay tuned!

[u]ADDITIONS[/u]
Autosave
[list]
    [*]We have added Autosave to the game. After every 2 minutes, the current level will be saved in a single Autosave slot. The game will also save after leaving the level. 
[/list]
Prop Interactions - Fan
[list]
    [*]The Fan Prop will now interact with other props.
    [*]Please Note: Any saved levels with Fan Props will now have this new behavior. You may need to edit your saved levels – or hilarity may ensue!
[/list]

[u]BUG FIXES[/u]
Cannon Prop
[list]
    [*]Made various improvements to the Cannon Prop.
[/list]

If there are any issues that you find, please let us know in the Steam Community page. Feel free to reach out to us on all social media platforms. If you have any suggestions, we would love to hear them, being new props, items, features, or levels. 

-	The Stunt Corgi Team

notes.title: Patch Notes – 1.0.2
notes.content:
We would like to thank everyone that bought the game at launch and gave us feedback.

[u]ADDITIONS[/u]
The tutorial has been expanded to cover the right hand context menu. Be sure to try it out!

[u]BUG FIXES[/u]
Various crashes have been addressed
[list]
    [*]Copying a VFX effect no longer crashes the game.
[/list]
Saves
[list]
    [*]Save Files no longer display incorrect save dates before a save file takes its place.
[/list]
Waypoints
[list]
    [*]Previewing a waypoint while Corgi rides the skateboard no longer prevents Corgi from moving.
[/list]
Audio
[list]
    [*]After a prop is thrown over the fence, generating the same prop will repeat the crashing sound effect.
[/list]

[u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u]
Portal
[list]
    [*]It is possible to spawn an entrance portal without an exit portal
    [*]WORKAROUND: Move the entrance (blue) portal and the exit (red) portal will appear.
[/list]
Crash
[list]
    [*]Spawning an Extreme amount of props and VFX may lead to a crash.
[/list]

If there are any issues that you find, please let us know in the Steam Community page. Feel free to reach out to us on all social media platforms. If you have any suggestions, we would love to hear them, being new props, items, features, or levels. 

-	The Stunt Corgi Team

notes.title: STUNT CORGI IS LIVE! Patch Notes – 1.0.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes – 1.0.1

Hello everyone! Stunt Corgi VR is Live! We are so excited to show off our loveable Corgi for you to play with. While you play with her, be aware of the following known issues: 

[b][u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u][/b]

[b]Audio[/b]
- After a prop is thrown over the fence, generating the same prop will repeat the crashing sound effect.

[b]Saves[/b]
- Save Files may display errant save dates before a save file takes its place.
 
[b]Corgi[/b]
- Corgi’s head may move oddly when she walks in a circle while costumes are being applied.

- Corgi can, on rare occasions, stop moving around the backyard. If this occurs, save your progress, enter the title screen on the blackboard, and then reload your level. This will be addressed in an upcoming patch.

If there are any issues that you find, please let us know in the Steam Community page. We will review each one. If you have any suggestions, we would love to hear them, being new props, items, features, or levels. 


-	The Stunt Corgi Team
